_comment: Bounded, versioned alternate names for occupational skills, each checked by hand against a public source on 2026-11-03. Exact phrases only: no fuzzy matching, and 'related' can only ever give Possible. Written as the shared tokenizer produces them (see skill_relations.json). Adapted by CareerOS, not copied wholesale: USDOL/ETA and the European Commission have not approved, endorsed, or tested this mapping. See docs/TERMINOLOGY_RESEARCH.md.
